reason: Provides DeepSeek Harness web_search and web_fetch providers backed by fastCRW, including search, page retrieval, and Markdown scraping through a configurable cloud or self-hosted endpoint.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 fastCRW 的网页搜索和网页抓取能力，并将页面内容转换为 Markdown。
summaries.en: Adds fastCRW-backed web search and web fetching to DeepSeek Harness, returning retrieved page content as Markdown.

capabilities: Performs web searches through the configured fastCRW endpoint
Fetches and scrapes web pages into Markdown
Uses an API key or self-hosted endpoint configuration
May escalate requests through browser-based retrieval tiers
